pages.text: A stabilizer that a redstone signal turned off can take the damage of critical entropy. Put Organa fluid source blocks next to it.$(br2)When an overload or a critical event happens in its area, the crystal absorbs it. The effect does not happen. One Organa fluid source next to the crystal is used up.
Without Organa fluid next to the crystal, the effect happens as normal. An active stabilizer needs no absorption. It does not work in the Entropy biome.
